name: B10-0108/2025 (PPE) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 election was rigged and does not recognise the government that came out of it. It backs President Salome Zourabichvili as the country's only legitimate representative. It asks for new elections within a few months and for sanctions on Georgian leaders, judges and police. It wants the European Union to stop high-level contacts and most financial support, and to give the frozen 120 million euros to civil society and independent media instead.

- **What changes:** The European Union is asked to sanction Georgian leaders, cut high-level contacts and most funding, and move 120 million euros to civil society.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, judges and police, its protesters and journalists, and Georgian civil society groups.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament has no power to act alone; European Union governments and the Commission must decide whether to do any of this.
